params.body:
## Why

Shane on preview: the garage screen (Instellingen, and "Mijn garage" for a dealer) takes a lot of room: a card inside a card, the theme's page-titles row, every pane padded twice, and the title reading "Dealer Aanpassen: StockCars" on the dealer's own garage.

## What changed (layout only; same fields, same names, same PUT)

- The theme's `page-titles` row becomes the app's `ui-page-head`. On the dealer's own sheet the title is "Garage: <naam>" with one quiet line under it; on the administrator's dealer sheet the title stays what it was, with the way back to the overview left of it.
- One card (`ui-form-card--wide`) instead of a card inside a card; the tab bar sits on the card's top edge and the panes start straight under it, so every pane loses its second padding.
- Save moved to the bottom right of the card behind a hairline (`ui-form-actions`), full width on a phone.
- Four language files gained the garage title, the lead sentence and the section labels.

## Not in this PR

The fields inside the Bedrijf pane keep their current two-column grid; regrouping them into Adres / Contact / Logo sections is the next step and touches `_tabs/form.blade.php` only.

## Tests

`CompiledViewsTest`, `AlpineExpressionTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, `HandlerWiringTest`, `LanguageParityTest`, `SmokeTest`, `RulesSourcesTest`: 291 tests, 1322 assertions (1 pre-existing incomplete). `php bin/rules-sources`: Geen problemen.
params.title: Garage screen: one card, page head, tab bar on the card edge
